build_TorchNativeAttnBackend: build a TorchNativeAttnBackend instance from a ModelRunner for native PyTorch attention
run_forward_extend: run the forward extend pass using torch native SDPA with KV cache and per-sequence processing
run_forward_decode: run the forward decode pass using torch native SDPA with single-token generation per sequence
init_forward_metadata: init forward metadata for a forward batch pass with a ForwardBatch argument
check_support_triton: check whether the attention backend supports Triton by returning False
